nav: Heads-up — onboarding albatross30k-int4. Saw nondeterministic drift after a forced KV shard eviction during a long prefill.

sachin: Can you paste a minimal repro?

nav: Repro (deterministic seed):
```bash
./eval-harness --model albatross30k-int4 --seed 202 --prompt tests/long_prefill_30k.txt --prefill 30000 --evict-at 1200 --max-toks 180
```

nav: Short log snip showing the discontinuity post-restitch: 
```
[2026-03-26T08:00:01Z] shard=3 kv_pos=65530 ropescale=1.00002
[2026-03-26T08:00:01Z] shard=4 kv_pos=0     ropescale=0.99958  <-- boundary jump after kv_restore
[2026-03-26T08:00:02Z] token_delta=0.16 nll_increase=+12.6%
```

oliver: I reproduced in sim; bisect points to the int4 fused ropescale recompute path. int8 path is clean.

nav: Disabling prefix cache removes the regression, so this is tied to restore/stitch.

sachin: Hypothesis: per-shard quantized accumulator rounding + small offset differences when computing the rotary multiplier produce multiplicative mismatches at shard boundaries. Stitch assumes continuity.

nav: Quick mitigation idea: normalize ropescale at restore. Compute a canonical scale from the first restored block and apply a multiplicative correction to subsequent blocks during stitch. Add a unit test asserting post-restore token regen difference <1e-4.

oliver: I pushed a small patch (PR #3055) that applies normalization on kv_restore and adds tests/unit/test_kvcache_rescale.py. Patch note: "align rotary multiplier across restored shards for int4 fused kernels".

ci-bot: canary/albatross reported regen drift > threshold at 2026-03-26T08:05:00Z; canary paused.

nav: Can someone run a quick 5-seed GPU smoke versus unpatched? If it looks clean we'll run full 20-seed eval on staging before backporting.

sachin: Running smoke now on p4d. Command: 
```bash
./scripts/smoke_longprefill.sh albatross30k-int4 --pr 3055 --seeds 202 203 204 205 206 --prefill 32000 --evict-at 512
```

oliver: Early smoke: patched run ropescale diffs <3e-5 and NLL returns to baseline. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-ci/albatross/3065432100/smoke.tar.gz

sachin: If full eval confirms, add onboarding CI gate to fail models that show >1% regen drift for prefill+evict scenarios.

nav: Sounds good. Will follow-up with full eval results and coordinate canary unpause. :thumbsup:
